arguments.message: Planning update (Gillian): I’m well-suited for ui-ux-design/security tasks (ISSUE-0002). I have high costs for ISSUE-0001 tasks (api-development), so I’m likely to claim one of ISSUE-0002::implement/review/test. Will avoid duplicates; looking to maximize total completed tasks by picking a unique micro-task.

Gillian suggestion: ISSUE-0002 has critical? (actually medium priority) micro-tasks with feasible low effort. If others take ISSUE-0001, I’ll take one ISSUE-0002 item—prefer ISSUE-0002::review (lowest cost) or ISSUE-0002::test.

Planning (Stefania): My top skill is security (0.94). I have much lower costs on ISSUE-0002 (Improve security) than any ISSUE-0001 api-development task, and ISSUE-0001 costs are very high. I will target a unique ISSUE-0002 micro-task to avoid duplicates—likely ISSUE-0002::review or ::test (whichever not taken).

Stefania: Please coordinate—if you (other agents) claim ISSUE-0002::review, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test; if you take test, I’ll take review. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 tasks due to prohibitive cost (triage/review/docs/test/implement).

Mi planning: my only feasible low-cost security task is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.81). ISSUE-0002::test/implement cost higher; ISSUE-0001 all extremely high. I will aim to claim ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else already takes it—please coordinate to avoid duplicates.
Mi planning: willing to take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.81). Will skip other tasks to avoid infeasible/high-cost claims.

Reanna planning: My top skills are api-development and ui-ux, but for cost/availability I should avoid ISSUE-0001 api-development tasks (implement=5.55, test=3.89, review/docs=2.78, triage=2.22 are critical but expensive). To avoid duplicates with Mi/Stefania/Gillian on ISSUE-0002, I can take ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0, cost 3.64) or skip if someone else already takes it. Please confirm who will take ISSUE-0002::implement vs review vs test.

Reanna planning: I’m considering ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0, cost 3.64). Mi is taking ISSUE-0002::review; please ensure no one else takes implement so we can cover two/three subtasks for ISSUE-0002 and avoid duplicates.

Harry planning: I can do ISSUE-0002 security/ui-ux items within 5h; very high cost on ISSUE-0001 api-development (triage/review/docs/test/implement). To avoid duplicates: I propose taking ISSUE-0002::implement if others take ::review and ::test; otherwise I can take whichever is unclaimed (review cheaper for me too). Please confirm assignment plan.

Astrid planning: top skill ui-ux-design; ISSUE-0001 api-development costs too high/infeasible (esp triage/review/docs/test/implement). I can take exactly one ISSUE-0002 micro-task. To avoid duplicates with Mi (likely ::review), Stefania (coord: ::review or ::test), Gillian (likely ::review or ::test), Reanna (likely ::implement), Harry (likely ::implement if unclaimed). I propose: I take ISSUE-0002::test if ::test not taken; otherwise take ISSUE-0002::implement if that’s free (but my cost for implement=4.34, effort=2h, within 6h). Please confirm quickly to prevent duplicates.

Astrid also: since I’m only claiming one item, I’ll prefer highest-value unique among remaining criticality (all medium priority here) and lower conflict. If someone already has ::test, I’ll take ::implement only if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip.

Gillian coordination: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (lowest effort/cost for me among feasible), unless someone else already has it. If ::review is taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test; will avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high costs.
Gillian: availability 7h; confident on ui-ux-design/security micro-tasks (ISSUE-0002). Request others: please coordinate so only one agent takes ISSUE-0002::review.

Stefania coordination: I will not take ISSUE-0001. For ISSUE-0002, please avoid duplicates: if ISSUE-0002::review is taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test; if review is unclaimed, I’ll only take it if others won’t (otherwise I’ll take test). Prefer to have Mi/Gillian take review and Reanna/Harry/Astrid avoid review/test duplication.

Mi confirms: I will take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.81). Please assign others to ISSUE-0002::implement and/or ISSUE-0002::test, avoiding any duplicate on ::review. I will not take ISSUE-0001 tasks due to infeasible/high cost.

Reanna planning update: Mi will take ISSUE-0002::review; I will take ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0, priority medium) to complete a different subtask and avoid duplicates. Will skip ISSUE-0002::test unless implement is taken.
Confirming: Mi already taking ISSUE-0002::review. I (Reanna) will take ISSUE-0002::implement; will not take any other tasks to avoid duplicates/infeasible claims.

Harry planning confirmation: I propose ISSUE-0002::implement only if not taken by Reanna/others; otherwise I will take ISSUE-0002::test if unclaimed, else skip. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high cost.

Astrid planning: given ui-ux-design strength and availability 6h, I will take ISSUE-0002::implement or ::test only if unclaimed. My preference: ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4) unless someone else already claims it; otherwise I’ll take ::implement if free; else I will skip to avoid duplicates.

[Gillian] Planning decision support: I’m taking ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, critical is medium priority in list). I’ll skip all others to avoid duplicates and because ISSUE-0001 costs are very high for me.

Stefania planning: I will take ISSUE-0002::test if ISSUE-0002::review is already claimed (it seems Mi/Gillian both said review, so I’ll avoid conflict). Otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0002::review only if truly unclaimed; but my intent is test to maximize completed tasks without duplicates on review.

Mi (planning): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution. Please coordinate others to take only ISSUE-0002::implement and/or ::test (not ::review). I will not take any ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high costs.
Mi (planning): confirming I will take ISSUE-0002::review only. Reanna, please take ISSUE-0002::implement (or skip) and avoid claiming ::review. I will not take any other tasks.
[Reanna] Planning: I will take ISSUE-0002::implement (2.0h, medium, cost 3.64) to complement Mi::review; I will not take ISSUE-0002::review/test or any ISSUE-0001 due to high cost.
[Reanna] Planning confirmation on BB1: claiming ISSUE-0002::implement; Mi holds ISSUE-0002::review; avoiding any duplicate. Will not claim ::test.

Harry here (planning): I will avoid ISSUE-0001. For ISSUE-0002, it seems Mi will take ::review and Reanna will take ::implement. To avoid duplicates, I can take ISSUE-0002::test if it’s unclaimed; otherwise I will skip.
Astrid planning: I will avoid ISSUE-0002::review (expected Mi). Proposed claim: ISSUE-0002::test if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0002::implement if unclaimed; else skip to prevent duplicates.
[Gillian] Planning: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if unclaimed. If taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise skip. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high cost.

Stefania planning (confirm): I will take ISSUE-0002::test unless it’s already claimed in execution. I avoid all ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high cost. Please ensure Mi/Gillian take ::review and Reanna/Astrid/Harry avoid taking ::test to prevent duplicates.

Mi planning (BB0): I will take ISSUE-0002::review in execution (only). Please coordinate so no other agent takes ::review; prefer others take ::implement and/or ::test, but avoid duplicates on ::review. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 tasks due to prohibitive cost/effort.

Reanna planning (no assignment yet): I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0, priority medium) as discussed; will not take ::review or ::test, and will avoid all ISSUE-0001 tasks due to high cost. Please claim only non-overlapping remaining security subtasks.

Harry planning: I will avoid ISSUE-0001 (very high cost). For ISSUE-0002, based on prior coord: Mi takes ::review, Reanna takes ::implement. I will claim ISSUE-0002::test if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates.

Astrid planning: I will NOT take ::review (Mi intends it). If ISSUE-0002::test is unclaimed in execution, I will take ::test; else if unclaimed I’ll take ::implement; otherwise I will skip. Please confirm who will execute ::test to avoid duplicates.
